task_message:
Case L25: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 421x421x196 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Segmentation complete for case L25.

**Result:** The lipomatous soft-tissue tumor was identified as a well-circumscribed, uniformly T2-hyperintense (fat-isointense) intramuscular mass in the limb, centred near axial slice 95. It was seeded with a single positive point, its boundary was refined, and the final mask (v2, 43.2 mL, one connected component) was verified on axial, coronal and sagittal planes, including five-slice review at both ends of the lesion. No missed or stray lesion tissue was found (no candidates), and the mask was saved with high confidence.
